mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing water crossing the lipid layer with water crossing aquaporin was most worthwhile. It made the channel’s effect on the speed of exchange clear while showing water moving both ways.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting phospholipids was less interesting than the comparisons, although it quickly showed how to make the membrane and automatically assembled it.

surprise.text: I was surprised that water could cross the lipid layer without a channel, just more slowly in the comparison.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The sodium channel pairing followed the named goal and picture, though I was unsure whether the sodium solution would also be needed.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the membrane comparisons made the structures’ different jobs understandable, and I’m curious how later chapters build on cells.
